<div class="card-body">
'''Out Of Commission''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">作動不能</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の支配フェイズに2フォースを使用して牽引ビームにつかまった宇宙船を脱出させる（「中央コア」が場に出ている場合、「デス・スター牽引ビーム」には効果がない）。2：相手のロストデッキか「ブラスター収納ラック」からランダムに1枚のカードを選んでゲームから除外する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Out-Of-Commission-SWCA-67688.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「じいさん、牽引ビームを作動不能にしてくれたんだろうな。さもなきゃ、すぐに後戻りだぜ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Out Of Commission.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: During your control phase, use 2 Force to free a starship held by a Tractor Beam. If Central Core is on table, this has no effect on Death Star Tractor Beam.

2: Randomly take one card from opponent's Lost Pile or Blaster Rack and place it out of play.

'''Lore:'''
Old man, you got the tractor beam out of commission, right? Otherwise turning back at once is required.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses numbered choose-one, ロストデッキ, ブラスター収納ラック, and ゲームから除外.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Out Of Commission]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
